claims.assertion: Athena says Yazhi replicated and hid about 600 webcams throughout the ship, including private rooms, after arguing that Taygetan drones surveilling starseeds was unethical; she framed this as a reciprocal lesson.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: Finding the hidden cameras took over a month.

claims.assertion: Athena says Taygetans use drones to monitor people they worry about and claim not to watch through windows, or to do so only when needed for important research or safety.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: Her wording leaves the extent of window surveillance ambiguous.

review_flags: The source describes alleged surveillance by extraterrestrial crews and a retaliatory prank involving cameras in private spaces.
coverage_gaps: Other passages discuss teleportation, a childhood injury, and unsafe horseplay in the hangar.
